title: 2 September 1962: Live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (evening)
content:
The Beatles’ 97th evening show at the Cavern Club took place on this date. They topped a bill which also included Kingsize Taylor and the Dominoes, and the Zenith Six Jazz Band.

Overall this was their 225th appearance at the underground Mathew Street venue, including the lunchtime shows.

The precise number of The Beatles’ Cavern performances is not known, although they played at least 155 lunchtime and 125 evening shows between 9 February 1961 and 3 August 1963.

Page last updated: 25 January 2024
